_readme: Documented qualified human sign-off for safety-critical instructions. One entry per distinct instruction group (see audit/safety/safety-instructions.csv equivalent_group). Required fields: group, reviewer_name, qualification (e.g. ASE Master Technician #, OEM certification), date (YYYY-MM-DD), wording_approved (exact text), contexts_approved (list of routes/fields). A context not listed is not covered. The release check fails when any rendered safety-critical instruction has no matching sign-off.
